rows.grounds: fused enumeration: āpas + ca + eva + apavatsaḥ + ca

items.question: Which additional divine figures are included in this segment of the enumeration?
premises: The preceding verses list a sequence of named figures.
This verse continues that sequence with further names.
Āpas, Apavatsa, Savitṛ, and Sāvitraka are named here.
items.inference: The enumeration extends to include Āpas, Apavatsa, Savitṛ, and Sāvitraka.
uncertainties: The precise identity or role of Apavatsa and Sāvitraka in this context is not specified.
items.plain_english: And Āpas, and also Apavatsa, and Savitṛ as well, and Sāvitraka.
